findings.title: testCacheMaxCount(null) expects a rolling upgrade but never enables the rolling-updates feature
findings.body: In UpgradeTest, createInitialDeployment returns early when updateStrategy is null (line 105-107), so the Keycloak CR for the null-strategy case never gets Profile.Feature.ROLLING_UPDATES added to spec.features.enabled. However, testCacheMaxCount expects eventuallyRollingUpgradeStatus when the strategy is null. With this PR, the update-compatibility check command now exits with code 4 (FEATURE_DISABLED) and prints 'The preview feature rolling-updates is not enabled' when the feature is off, so the operator can no longer report a rolling upgrade for that deployment. The null-strategy parameterized invocation of testCacheMaxCount will therefore fail/timeout waiting for a rolling-upgrade status that can never occur.

findings.title: Feature-disabled test does not assert the new exit code 4
findings.body: testFeatureNotEnabled only asserts the error message. The PR introduces a new, documented exit code (CompatibilityResult.FEATURE_DISABLED = 4) that automation is supposed to rely on (the docs tell users to rely only on exit codes), but no test verifies that the command actually exits with 4 when the feature is disabled. A regression that returns the wrong exit code would go unnoticed.
